picks.headline: New method teaches AI to make 2D designs 3D
picks.excerpt: A new AI technique converts flat 2D designs into usable 3D geometry, a workflow shift directly relevant to how game artists could turn concept art into game-ready assets. PC Gamer walks through what the method does and where it could plug into asset-creation pipelines.

picks.headline: "A couple of companies have managed to ignite a culture war": Games AI veteran says it can be useful, but we've made mountains out of ChatGPT's molehills
picks.excerpt: Veteran games-AI researcher Luke Dicken argues the industry's real opportunity is richer, more adaptive player experiences and smarter production tooling -- not replacing human talent -- and that the loudest genAI hype and backlash have both overshot the actual craft. A grounded read on where machine learning genuinely changes how games get designed and balanced.
